MedicCaduceusFeedback.name: Caduceus Feedback
MedicCaduceusFeedback.description: Increases Attack Range by 1.1 and Basic Attacks against Heroes generate 4 Energy.

MedicLifeSupport.name: Life Support
MedicLifeSupport.description: During the first 2 seconds of Energy regeneration, Healing Beam regenerates 100% more Energy. Passive: Increase your maximum Energy by 10.

MedicClear.name: Clear!
MedicClear.description: Quest: Each enemy Hero hit with Displacement Grenade restores 3 Energy. Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, reduce the cooldown of Displacement Grenade from 12 seconds to 9 seconds. Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, increase the detonation area of Displacement Grenade by 25%.

MedicCellularReactor.name: Cellular Reactor
MedicCellularReactor.description: Consume 30 Energy to heal Lt. Morales for 30% of her maximum Health over 3 seconds. Caduceus Reactor is disabled while this is active. Passive: Generate 2 Energy each time Safeguard reduces damage, up to a maximum of 10 Energy per use.

MedicTraumaTrigger.name: Trauma Trigger
MedicTraumaTrigger.description: Taking damage while below 40% Health grants 40 Armor for 3 seconds. This effect has a 30 second cooldown. Passive: Increase the healing provided by Caduceus Reactor from 2% to 4% of Lt. Morales's maximum Health per second.

MedicBlastShield.name: Blast Shield
MedicBlastShield.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Displacement Grenade are Slowed by 50% for 1 second after being knocked away and grant Lt. Morales a Shield equal to 6% of her maximum Health. This shield stacks up to 5 times.

MedicPhysicalTherapy.name: Physical Therapy
MedicPhysicalTherapy.description: Safeguard removes all Slows from its target and its cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.

MedicVanadiumPlating.name: Vanadium Plating
MedicVanadiumPlating.description: While an ally affected by Safeguard is Stunned or Rooted, Safeguard grants an additional 20 Armor. Passive: Increase the duration of Safeguard by 1 second.

MedicMediDrone.name: Medi-Drone
MedicMediDrone.description: Allies with Safeguard receive 75% of the healing done by Healing Beam on another ally.

MedicHeroicAbilityStimDrone.name: Stim Drone
MedicHeroicAbilityStimDrone.description: Grant an allied Hero 75% Attack Speed and 25% Movement Speed for 10 seconds.

MedicHeroicAbilityMedivacDropship.name: Medivac Dropships
MedicHeroicAbilityMedivacDropship.description: Unlock the Medivac Dropship and Reinforcements abilities. These abilities share a cooldown. Medivac Dropship Target a location for a Medivac transport. For up to 10 seconds before takeoff, allies can right-click to enter the Medivac. Reinforcements Call down a Medivac Dropship at

MedicEMPGrenade.name: EMP Grenade
MedicEMPGrenade.description: Displacement Grenade deals an additional 96 (+4% per level) damage over 2 seconds, and up to 400 (+4% per level) bonus damage to Shields.

MedicSystemShock.name: System Shock
MedicSystemShock.description: Heroes hit by Displacement Grenade deal 30% less damage for 3 seconds.

MedicBedsideManner.name: Bedside Manner
MedicBedsideManner.description: Heroes hit by Displacement Grenade will take an additional 6% of maximum Health as damage from Lt. Morales's next Basic Attack against them. Passive: Basic Attacks against Heroes deal an additional 1% of maximum Health as damage.

MedicExtendedCare.name: Extended Care
MedicExtendedCare.description: Channeling Healing Beam on a Hero for at least 3 seconds causes them to be healed for 258 (+4% per level) over 3 seconds when Healing Beam ends. Passive: Increase the range of Healing Beam by 30%.

MedicFirstResponder.name: First Responder
MedicFirstResponder.description: While above 60 Energy, Healing Beam's healing is increased by 20% and both Lt. Morales and her Healing Beam target gain 15% Movement Speed.

MedicShieldSequencer.name: Shield Sequencer
MedicShieldSequencer.description: Safeguard gains a second charge and its range is increased by 60%.

MedicHyperactivity.name: Hyperactivity
MedicHyperactivity.description: Reduce the cooldown of Stim Drone from 70 seconds to 35 seconds, and increase the Movement Speed bonus from 25% to 50%.

MedicSafeZone.name: Safe Zone
MedicSafeZone.description: After exiting the Medivac, allies are Protected from all damage for 3 seconds. Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Medivac Dropship abilities by 15 seconds.

MedicHospiceCare.name: Hospice Care
MedicHospiceCare.description: Safeguard grants its target Unkillable for 1 second. If the target is under 50% maximum Health when the Unkillable effect ends, they are healed for 8% of their maximum Health.

MedicSecondOpinion.name: Second Opinion
MedicSecondOpinion.description: Hitting 2 or more Heroes with Displacement Grenade reduces its cooldown to 2 seconds.
